criteria.text: Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $34,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $33,180,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Brightwater Foods Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Lists valid board approval of the transaction as a required approval and states it has not been validly obtained.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($35,000,000 - $910,000 = $34,090,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
